decision_rule: Report all six paired SOC differences by two tasks, plus every makespan/cost/failure. If strict SOC differences switch sign across seeds within a task, or apparent benefit is only more repair attempts without retained full-plan quality gain, stop expanding this specific candidate. Zero or worse outcomes remain. No added seeds/maps, reruns, budget widening, reward changes, training or automatic next batch.
interpretation: Known design tasks, three new solver seeds per task. Within-task paired descriptive evidence only; two task units, no significance or unseen-task generalization claim. No equal-work speedup from different repair counts. PRIMARY_DONE omissions are listed from raw stages; settlement duration is not a commit timestamp.
validation_method: Direct original manifest, exact ordered jobs and planned_items authorization, receipt/hash checks; common discrete validator on retained initial/final paths and native final.paths; reward verifier for actual posterior/plan identity/censor/cost; independent raw PRIMARY_DONE stage review and validation-duration witnesses; new pair deltas computed from original full final paths.
